purpose: Phase 5B real-data validation metadata only; no raw archive or CSV is stored in this repository.

dataset.name: BYU MERS Consolidated Stats Antarctic Iceberg Database
dataset.organization: Brigham Young University Microwave Earth Remote Sensing Laboratory; consolidated BYU/NIC data
dataset.format: ZIP archive of one CSV per iceberg track

validated_schema.observed_position_quality: least significant bit of flags; 1 means at least one contributing observed position, 0 means all contributing positions are interpolated
validated_schema.consecutive_pair_rule: date_gap == 1 and parsed timestamp difference is exactly 24 hours
validated_schema.longitude_rule: normalize longitude differences across the antimeridian before displacement calculation

data_quality_policy_required_before_trai: Exclude malformed date rows until an authoritative interpretation is documented.
Use only chronological, duplicate-free, consecutive 24-hour pairs with observed-position quality at both endpoints.
Apply antimeridian-aware longitude handling before any geographic displacement calculation.
Treat size equal to zero as unavailable, not a measured iceberg size.
